[quote=united_hydronia;59973867][spoiler=[b]The retreat from Nestorstaat[/b]]
As the fleet continued to be pummelled by missiles and the unsuccessful attempts by the aircraft, the Hydronian commanders made the decision to retreat. All the jets were called back into the aircraft carriers. It took some manoeuvring, but thanks to the use of radar homing interceptor missiles mounted on the Hydronian destroyers, most of the jets were able to land safely back on the remaining aircraft carriers. 

As what was left of the fleet retreated south towards the BR Bob, the amphibious landing vessels and submarines also attempted escape, but the mines and other defences stopped them, a costly loss for Hydronia.

The remaining fleet continued south, but after receiving intelligence about ships in the vicinity of bob, turned west and headed back towards the Hydronian mainland.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Protection of the homeland[/b]]
With much of the antiair destroyed, Hydronia needed new tactics. The squadrons of jets split up, to prevent the so called gunslinger missiles from being able to hit a clumped up target.

The incoming cruise missiles would be dealt with by a backup air defence system, situated far behind the coastal line of defences. This defence system activated after the main defence system had already been hit by the homing missiles, so it provided a short timeframe between the firing of the next round of homing missiles to counterattack. Anti-air missiles streaked into the air towards the incoming Kaiserreich jets, releasing chaff at the same time to confuse the missiles guidance systems.

The dry docks took a direct hit, but no ships were docked at the time.

As Hypersonic missiles rushed towards the incoming Hydronian ships, the fleet would have no choice but to launch a counterattack of their own. A barrage of cruise missiles would be launched, before the fleet began moving away from the Hypersonic missiles to suffer minimum damage. The Xhawk-6 jets began launching air-to-surface missiles as well.
[/spoiler] [/quote]
